feeContract.exactOutput: monotonic gross such that gross minus sum(streamDelta(gross)) equals requestedNet

treasuryControls.unpauseProcessClaims: Treasury-only when no emergency rotation is pending
treasuryControls.scheduleOperationsRotation: Treasury-only; uses the immutable 43200-second delay; clears and freezes ordinary Operations handover; auto-pauses; only a new Treasury intent may supersede it with a fresh delay; history never clears
treasuryControls.executeOperationsRotation: Treasury-only after the scheduled 43200-second delay; replaces Operations and leaves claims paused

rotation.treasuryReschedule: requires a new Treasury intent and starts a new delay

steps: allocate complete HKMN supply via token.allocate(hook)
Permit2 pull at most 240000000 atomic USDG
PositionManager mint full HKMN allocation to custody
ownerSeedTransaction.failure: roll back seed-local state only and allow retry

preSeed.hookHkmn: the complete HKMN allocation is held at the hook and non-transferable to every other recipient until seed succeeds
preSeed.swaps: unavailable because the initialized pool has no liquidity

minimaAndGasCaps.moneyMinimums: every money minimum is an explicit TypedAmount

providerAttempt.notSent: pre-call failure; retryable before provider contact
providerAttempt.sentUnknown: post-send ambiguity; observation-only and never resent

chainAttempt.restart: revalidate persisted approvedSemanticsDigest before any rebroadcast

relaySettlement.amountEncoding: source and destination amounts are TypedAmount fields split into their named components; netDeltaAtomic is an integer string in destination-asset units
relaySettlement.transactionHashUniqueness: each sourceTxHash and destinationTxHash attributes to exactly one RelayLegV1 across all cycles and directions
relaySettlement.settlement: SETTLED only after this process observes both finalized chain deltas through its own RPC clients and attributes the destination delta by matching amount, time window, and memo or relayRequestId; Relay status alone never settles a leg
relaySettlement.fundingIsolation: outbound uses only the cycle claimed principal; return uses only the cycle-attributed proceeds delta

standingAuthority.firstUse: check wall-clock expiry and atomically persist the decision with its day-cap and nonce reservations before any signable action
standingAuthority.expiry: an expired authority is refused at first use
standingAuthority.replay: replaying the persisted decision is idempotent and cannot reserve a second cap or nonce

invariants: totalAtomic.amountAtomic equals unitPriceAtomic.amountAtomic multiplied by quantity
all money fields use the existing typed amount shape

cycleMode.persistence: stored in CycleRepository at creation and immutable for the cycle
cycleMode.isolation: production services refuse rehearsal cycles and rehearsal services refuse production cycles

custodyLedger.scope: EVM USDG canonical row only in this revision; a non-EVM-USDG row stays on hookemon.custody-ledger.v1, or, if migrated, stays permanently unvalued and fail-closed under the admission rule below, until a separately approved evidence producer exists for it
custodyLedger.verifiedCurrentBalance: CustodyBalanceObservationV1 | null -- {schema, account, balance: TypedAmount, finality: {height, hash, timestampUnixSeconds}}; for the EVM USDG row, produced only by a dedicated public/archive/public-recheck finalized-balance reader reusing payout-availability.mjs's evidence discipline; null permitted only on a key's first-ever write; no non-null-to-null erasure and no v2-to-v1 downgrade
custodyLedger.obligations: tracked separately from verified balance; unresolved principal is counted once
custodyLedger.expectedCycleAssets: singular TypedAmount | null per row (field name expectedCycleAsset, never a collection); a second unresolved return-direction leg for the same resolved chain/asset is refused before append, leaving the row's existing value unchanged
custodyLedger.unattributedExternalDeposits: separate classification that pauses new claims
custodyLedger.admissionRule: unvaluedExposure becomes true for the EVM USDG row when verifiedCurrentBalance is null while unresolvedClaim is positive or any current-custody bucket is nonzero; a row with a non-null verifiedCurrentBalance is never marked unvalued by this rule

nonEvmEvidenceConstructionContract.trustInputs: a caller-pinned canonical {chainId, assetId, decimals, mint, owner, tokenProgramId} identity plus two independently configured finalized-commitment read sides; performs no RPC I/O and selects no chain/asset identity itself
nonEvmEvidenceConstructionContract.status: an allowed pure combiner shape only; not itself a durable producer, canonical chain/asset identity source, custody-ledger writer, valuation, or live readiness proof for any row

custodyLedger.liveBindingStatus: no bindings/index.json entry exists for this interface; none is created until a real, independently approved binding path, digest, and value exist

formats: Solana v0 with address lookup tables

wireSchema.authority: the runner canonical validator is authoritative
wireSchema.adapterDecoder: must emit the identical canonical schema

providerSpecificPurchasePolicy.trustInputs: binding bytes and expectedDigest are independently supplied and digest-verified before the schema is read; durable per-cycle facts; an independently observed RPC blockhash context; candidate transaction bytes are never a legal factory input and are evaluated only by this same hookemon.transaction-policy.v1 decode/evaluate kernel
providerSpecificPurchasePolicy.liveBindingStatus: no live Collector program, account, provider co-signer, mint, expectedDigest source, or repository binding path is approved; no bindings/index.json entry exists for this interface

algorithm: prove completeness through second source or archive RPC

durability.walletNonceLock: one repository-backed lock covers claim, outbound, return, and payout
durability.signedRecords: SIGNED records remain durable and recoverable after restart
durability.droppedBroadcast: resolve by receipt search or replacement using the same nonce and calldata
durability.frozenRecipient: quarantine the liability without blocking the rest of the manifest
durability.dustCarry: persist and atomically consume provenance-bound carry between cycles

policyEngine.epicRule: hold iff offerAtomic * 100 < insuredValueAtomic * 40; equality sells
policyEngine.held: HELD_* is fail-closed, alarmed, never-auto-sold, and blocks-new-claims-in-v1
policyEngine.rehearsal: runner mode with bounded cycles, cap, restart injection, and evidence JSON
